claims.claim: The New York Times reported that Democrats wrested control of Congress from Republicans and that Republicans lost the House and the Senate.
claims.episode_span: Republicans lost both the House and the Senate
claims.source_title: How a Blue Wave Became a Red Wipeout
claims.supporting_quote: Republicans lost control of the House and Senate as voters offered a stinging rebuke to President Trump’s agenda.

claims.claim: The New York Times reported the House result ended a Republican trifecta and cemented divided government after two years in which Republicans ceded power to President Trump.
claims.episode_span: ended a Republican trifecta and cemented divided government
claims.source_title: Democrats Seize Control of Congress, Ending a G.O.P. Trifecta
claims.supporting_quote: The party’s victory in the House cemented an era of divided government and a freshly assertive Congress after two years in which Republicans ceded power to President Trump.

claims.claim: The Times reported the backlash extended into deep red states and indicated Trump has lost his hold over the coalition that lifted him to the White House twice.
claims.episode_span: the backlash extended even into deep red states
claims.source_title: Angry Voters Usher in Beginning of the End to the Trump Era
claims.supporting_quote: The electoral backlash extended even into deep red states and indicated that President Trump has lost his hold over the coalition that lifted him to the White House twice.

claims.claim: The Times reported Senate victories in Iowa, Texas, and North and South Carolina.
claims.episode_span: a string of Senate victories in Iowa, Texas, and North and South Carolina
claims.source_title: Winning the Senate, Democrats Secure a Platform to Check Trump
claims.supporting_quote: In a stunning string of victories in Iowa, Texas, and North and South Carolina, Democrats delivered a midterm thrashing repudiating President Trump.

claims.claim: President Trump attributed sweeping losses to not being on the ballot, and others in his party dismissed that and blamed him.
claims.episode_span: others in his party dismissed that explanation and pinned the blame squarely on him
claims.source_title: After Midterm Drubbing, Trump and Republicans Start Pointing Fingers
claims.supporting_quote: While the president attributed sweeping losses to the fact that he was not on the ballot, others in his party dismissed his explanation and pinned blame squarely on him.

claims.claim: President Trump said, "There was a mood in the air, I guess."
claims.episode_span: There was a mood in the air, I guess.
claims.source_title: 8 Midterm Election Takeaways: A Democratic Landslide Punishes Trump’s Party
claims.supporting_quote: “There was a mood in the air, I guess,” he said.

claims.claim: Trump wrote on Truth Social that Republicans would have won in a landslide if his name had been on the ballot, and the BBC headlined that he says Democrats did a good job.
claims.episode_span: Republicans would have won "in a landslide" if his name had been on the ballot
claims.source_title: Trump takes aim at Republicans but says Democrats did a 'good job'
claims.supporting_quote: He wrote on Truth Social that Republicans would have won "in a landslide" if his name had been on the ballot.

claims.claim: Gina Hinojosa defeated Greg Abbott, denying him a fourth term, and is the first Hispanic candidate elected to lead Texas.
claims.episode_span: first Hispanic candidate elected to lead Texas
claims.source_title: Gina Hinojosa Wins Texas Governor Race in Major Upset, Defeating Greg Abbott
claims.supporting_quote: State Representative Gina Hinojosa defeated Gov. Greg Abbott, denying him a fourth term and becoming the first Hispanic candidate elected to lead the state.

claims.claim: The Times reported Hinojosa concentrated on pocketbook issues and that opposition to Republican immigration policies was a tailwind.
claims.episode_span: concentrated on pocketbook issues, and that voters' opposition to Republican immigration policies was a tailwind
claims.source_title: How Gina Hinojosa Captured Texas
claims.supporting_quote: The woman who took down Greg Abbott concentrated on pocketbook issues, but voters’ opposition to Republican immigration policies was a tailwind.

claims.claim: Victories by James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa upended decades of statewide Republican dominance in Texas, the Times reported.
claims.episode_span: victories by James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa upended decades of statewide Republican dominance
claims.source_title: ‘An Earthquake’: A Democratic Rout Stuns Texas
claims.supporting_quote: In a seismic shift that was once unthinkable, victories by James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa upended decades of statewide dominance in what had been the nation’s most populous conservative state.

claims.claim: Canada wants to commit to eight of twelve German submarines up front and leave four for later, which could jeopardize some of eighty-six billion dollars in promised economic benefits.
claims.episode_span: committing to eight up front and leaving the remaining four for a future decision
claims.source_title: Canada looking to Germany for 8 submarines up front and 4 later: sources
claims.supporting_quote: Sources tell CBC News the proposal is intended to preserve financial flexibility but could jeopardize some of the $86 billion in economic benefits promised by Germany.

claims.claim: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker and would be second in the presidential line of succession.
claims.episode_span: poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
claims.source_title: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
claims.supporting_quote: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.

claims.claim: Jeffries argued voters sent Congress a message to end extremism and corruption, and NPR headlined that he declares America is back.
claims.episode_span: a message to end extremism and "corruption."
claims.source_title: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries declares "America is back"
claims.supporting_quote: Jeffries, who addressed supporters after House control was called for Democrats , argued voters have sent Congress a message to end extremism and "corruption."

claims.claim: The New York Times reported Jeffries was raised by a Black nationalist family in Brooklyn, is a moderate, and loves a hip-hop reference, and that he said We Hear You.
claims.episode_span: raised by a Black nationalist family in Brooklyn, is a moderate, and loves a hip-hop reference
claims.source_title: Five Things to Know About Hakeem Jeffries
claims.supporting_quote: The New York Democrat who is in line to be the first Black speaker was raised by a Black nationalist family in Brooklyn, is a moderate and loves a hip-hop reference.

claims.claim: Angela Rimmer, 42, a single mother of four in the London, Ontario, area, has spent more than $5,000 on private menopause care Ontario does not cover.
claims.episode_span: spent more than five thousand dollars out of pocket on menopause care that Ontario does not cover
claims.source_title: Public menopause care is scarce, and private care is costly. Why Canadians pay either way
claims.supporting_quote: To date, she figures she’s spent more than $5,000.

claims.claim: Only British Columbia and Manitoba cover menopausal hormone therapy, and an Ipsos survey for GreenShield found four in ten Canadian women do not know where to get treatment.
claims.episode_span: just two provinces, British Columbia and Manitoba, cover the costs of menopausal hormone therapy
claims.source_title: Public menopause care is scarce, and private care is costly. Why Canadians pay either way
claims.supporting_quote: Currently, however, just two provinces – British Columbia and Manitoba – cover the costs of menopausal hormone therapy.

claims.claim: Abdul El-Sayed defeated Mike Rogers and will be the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate, NPR reported.
claims.episode_span: first Muslim American to serve in the Senate
claims.source_title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeats Republican Mike Rogers in key Michigan Senate race
claims.supporting_quote: With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.

claims.claim: Troy Jackson defeated Susan Collins, flipping a seat she held for nearly 30 years.
claims.episode_span: flipping a Senate seat she had held for nearly thirty years
claims.source_title: Troy Jackson wins Maine Senate race over Susan Collins, in major coup for Democrats
claims.supporting_quote: The result is a crucial victory for Democrats in their push to retake the Senate majority, flipping a seat that Collins has held for nearly 30 years.

claims.claim: The New York Times reported Collins was the sole Republican representing New England in Congress and lost after three decades in the Senate.
claims.episode_span: the sole Republican representing New England in Congress
claims.source_title: Susan Collins Loses to Troy Jackson in Maine, Ending Three Decades in the Senate
claims.supporting_quote: Senator Susan Collins, the sole Republican representing New England in Congress, lost her seat on a landslide night for Democrats.

claims.claim: Christina Bohannan won Iowa's 1st Congressional District and unseated Mariannette Miller-Meeks, with discontent about the war with Iran and tariffs cited by the Times.
claims.episode_span: unseated Representative Mariannette Miller-Meeks
claims.source_title: Bohannan Unseats Miller-Meeks in Iowa, Flipping Key House Seat
claims.supporting_quote: Discontent about the war with Iran and tariffs helped create a tough environment for Representative Mariannette Miller-Meeks, the defeated Republican.

claims.claim: The Nackawic pulp mill is shutting down because of prevailing market conditions, according to AV Group New Brunswick.
claims.episode_span: shutting down because of "prevailing market conditions," according to the India-based owner, AV Group New Brunswick
claims.source_title: As a New Brunswick pulp mill goes quiet, a forestry town waits for the axe to fall
claims.supporting_quote: The town’s mill, its lifeblood and the largest employer for half a century, is shutting down due to “prevailing market conditions,” according to the India-based owner, AV Group New Brunswick.

claims.claim: A leading Canadian climate scientist testified in Vancouver that Canada need not shut industries or take a catastrophic financial hit to fight climate change.
claims.episode_span: does not need to shut down its industries or take a catastrophic financial hit
claims.source_title: No catastrophic financial hit required to fight climate change, scientists say in landmark court case
claims.supporting_quote: Canada does not need to shut down its industries or take a catastrophic financial hit to effectively fight climate change, one of the country's leading climate scientists testified during a landmark trial in a Vancouver courtroom this week.

claims.episode_span: Russia will not compete at the World Junior Hockey Championship in Canada
claims.source_title: Russia Will Not Compete at World Junior Hockey Championship in Canada, PM Carney Says
claims.supporting_quote: Russia Will Not Compete at World Junior Hockey Championship in Canada, PM Carney Says

claims.claim: Deb Haaland will be the first woman Native American governor, and Peggy Flanagan is the first Native American woman elected to the Senate after defeating Michele Tafoya.
claims.episode_span: Deb Haaland of New Mexico will be the nation's first woman Native American governor
claims.source_title: Haaland and Flanagan, Two Native American Women, Break Political Barriers
